column2: (1) The general objects for which the Corporation is

column1: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column2: to take necessary steps to develop the Wariyapola
Rajamaha Viharaya in every aspect for the spiritual
advancement of the people and also to take steps to
make new additions to the Viharaya when required;
to  assist  to  develop  the  moral  values  of  the
community  and  to  take  relevant  measures  in  this
regard;
to  take  steps  to  establish,  maintain,  manage  and
develop  pirivenas  and  other  relevant  religious
institutions  for  the  academic  development  of
Bhikkus;
to implement programmes in respect of pre-schools,
day-care  centers,  homes  for  children  and  their
religious  education;
to  assist  to  enhance  the  welfare  facilities  and
benefits for Sri Lankan students who are unable to
pursue  their  education  due  to  poverty  and
disability;
to  conduct  necessary  classes,  lecturers,  seminars,
conferences,  workshops,  discussions,  dialogues,
educational  tours  and  exhibitions  with  a  view  to
promoting  education  for  Buddhist  bikkus  and
bikkunies;
to  provide  housing  for  the  benefit  of  the  poor,
elderly, destitute, and those with physical or mental
disabilities,  inaugurate  and  maintain  language
training and vocational training courses in order to
deploy  the  youth  in  productive  services  and  to
provide  facilities  for  the  purpose  of  generating
income  in  order  to  maintain  and  continue  such
training  course;
